tabs.html:
Tenda TX3000 Pro AX3000 Dual Band Gigabit Wi-Fi 6 Router

Elevate Your Home or Office Network with Cutting-Edge Wi-Fi 6 Technology

The Tenda TX3000 Pro is a high-performance router designed to meet the demands of modern internet usage. With its advanced Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax) technology, this router offers faster speeds, increased capacity, and improved efficiency for homes and offices with multiple connected devices.

Key Features:

  • Dual Band Speeds: Offers combined speeds up to 3000 Mbps—2402 Mbps on the 5 GHz band and 574 Mbps on the 2.4 GHz band—ensuring fast and stable connections for all your devices.
  • Six High-Gain Antennas: Equipped with six 6dBi external antennas to enhance signal strength and coverage, providing reliable Wi-Fi throughout your space.
  • Multiple Operating Modes: Supports Router Mode, Access Point Mode, and Universal Repeater Mode (Client+AP, WISP), offering versatile networking options.
  • Advanced Security: Features WPA2-PSK and WPA3-SAE encryption, along with WPS for quick and secure connections.
  • Parental Controls: Includes client filtering, URL filtering, and time limits to manage internet access for connected devices.
  • VPN Support: Supports IPSec, PPTP, and L2TP VPN protocols, allowing secure remote access to your network.
  • Mesh System Compatibility: Supports Tenda's Wi-Fi+ Mesh System for seamless coverage across larger areas.
  • App and Web Management: Manage your network settings easily through the Tenda Wi-Fi app or web interface.
  • Firmware Upgrades: Supports online firmware upgrades to keep your router up to date with the latest features and security patches.
